title: Battery management system DFMEA
goal: Present safety-relevant BMS failure modes, controls, and computed risk priorities.

rubric.must: The worksheet visibly identifies the battery management system and its safe-limit monitoring function.
Overcharge protection failure visibly links to thermal runaway or pack fire with severity 10.
Each visible failure row has severity, occurrence, detection, and computed RPN or action-priority fields.
The safety-critical overcharge rows are visibly highlighted as high priority.
Delayed overtemperature detection and incorrect state-of-charge estimation are visibly included as separate modes.
Redundant sensing, software assurance, diagnostics, or validation controls are visibly listed.
The worksheet uses readable aligned columns and distinguishes risk cells visually.
